headline: Power Mech secures Rs 320 crore order from Vedanta Aluminium
summary: Power Mech Projects has bagged an end-to-end operation and maintenance contract worth Rs 320 crore from Vedanta Aluminium. The deal covers a 130 MW coal-fired cogeneration power plant and a 90 MW Blowout Preventer at Lanjigarh, Odisha. Despite the order win, Power Mech shares were trading under pressure. Indian retail investors tracking infrastructure and power service providers should note the company's order book additions.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings delivery on order execution
why_it_matters: Order book expands despite short-term stock pressure
winners_losers: Power Mech gains / shareholders face pressure

headline: Power Mech Projects secures new orders and contracts
hook: New order wins added to order book
summary: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the stock exchanges that it has received new orders and contracts. The company provides engineering and construction services. Further financial details and the size of the contracts were not immediately disclosed in the filing. Retail investors track order inflows as an indicator of future revenue visibility for the infrastructure company.
why_it_matters: Order inflows signal revenue visibility for infrastructure investors

headline: Power Mech Projects to provide guarantees and indemnities to third parties
summary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed a notice with the NSE stating it will give guarantees, indemnities, and act as a surety for third parties. The filing does not disclose any specific contracts or amounts. The move increases the company’s potential liability exposure. Investors may view this as a risk factor but it is a routine corporate disclosure.
